blocks.text: According to some experts, we are leaving our children and grandchildren a frightening inheritance : an increased accumulation of so-called greenhouse gases in the atmosphere and the potentially disastrous climate changes that this increase may bring about. However, the scientific communityis not speaking with one voice . Other scientists claim that they evidence for global warming is inconclusive and argue that predictions based on it are questionable. The scientific debate has been intense. It has also fueled a political controversy about what measures, if any, should be taken to address the possible problem of climate changes.
